# Railway operations hard directive

- NEVER use Railway's AI agent for any task, investigation, deployment, diagnosis, validation, configuration change, log review, or infrastructure operation.
- Use only direct Railway controls/tools and direct repository inspection.
- Do not use Railway Preview deployments.
- Do not redeploy merely to perform a check that can be completed without deployment.
- Deploy only to Railway production when deployment is explicitly required and pre-deployment validation is complete.
- If a direct Railway operation is unavailable, use the next legitimate non-agent route or report the limitation; do not fall back to Railway's AI agent.
